jobs.description:
About the role

The Master Data / PLM Specialist is responsible for maintaining accurate product master data, Bills of Material (BOMs), and SAP production data throughout the product lifecycle. This role supports product releases, engineering changes, and new product introductions while ensuring data quality, governance compliance, and effective cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Quality teams.

Please note that this is a 12 month temporary assignment.

This is your new role:

- Product Data & BOM Maintenance: Create, update, and maintain product data and Bills of Material (BOMs), ensuring accuracy, consistency, and correct versioning throughout the product lifecycle.
- Change & Release Support: Support New Product Introductions (NPI) and updates by coordinating release readiness, verifying completeness, performing impact analysis, and assisting with approvals and release activities in PLM or related systems.
- SAP Production Material Master: Create and maintain SAP Production Material Masters and Production Versions to support production planning and execution.
- Data Quality & Governance: Apply data standards, naming conventions, and governance rules to maintain high data quality and prevent issues that could impact internal processes or customer-facing systems.
- Cross-functional Coordination: Collaborate closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, and other teams to ensure timely data updates, smooth approvals, and clear communication across stakeholders.
- Process Improvement & System Adoption: Support continuous improvement initiatives by documenting and optimizing workflows, promoting best practices, delivering training, and driving adoption of PLM systems across teams.

This is you:

- Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, IT or a related field or similar education with multiple years experience on a related field.
- Minimum 2 years of experience in data management, product administration, engineering support, or operational coordination, depending on educational credentials.
- Experience with PLM, ERP, or supply chain systems (Enovia, SAP, o9, or similar) is an advantage.
- Basic understanding of master data management, data accuracy, and structured processes.
- Hands-on working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and basic data analysis.
- Strong attention to detail and a structured, organized way of working.
- Good verbal and written communication skills in English (German will be an advantage)
- Collaborative mindset, with experience working in cross-functional teams.
- Proactive, supportive attitude with motivation to learn and grow in the role

Job Description

About the role

Nexperia is a global leader in essential semiconductors, enabling a sustainable future through innovation in automotive, industrial, mobile and consumer applications. As we continue to expand our Silicon Carbide (SiC) portfolio, we are looking for an experienced (Sr) Product Marketing Manager (m/f/d) to drive business growth, product strategy and market success across our SiC product portfolio.

This is a highly visible, international role where you will shape the future direction of our SiC business, working closely with R&D, operations, sales, quality and marketing teams to deliver innovative products and profitable growth

What you will do

- Own and manage the SiC product portfolio throughout the entire product lifecycle, including product positioning, specification definition, quality requirements and pricing strategy.
- Define and drive the SiC product roadmap, identifying opportunities for innovation, optimisation and business growth.
- Develop and execute the global SiC product strategy and long-term portfolio planning.
- Deliver annual revenue and margin targets by driving cross-functional initiatives and ensuring successful execution of business plans.
- Lead New Product Introduction (NPI) activities to achieve business case objectives and accelerate market adoption.
- Own business case development, execution and fulfilment throughout the product lifecycle.
- Conduct market intelligence activities, including competitor benchmarking, technology trend monitoring and application analysis.
- Act as the key interface between product marketing, development, operations, quality, sales and other Business Group stakeholders.
- Support customer engagement activities and translate market requirements into actionable product strategies

What you will need

- Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Semiconductor Physics or a related technical discipline.
- At least 7 years of experience in product marketing, product management or a similar commercial semiconductor role.
- Strong knowledge of power semiconductors, with experience in SiC, power electronics or related applications being highly desirable.
- Understanding of electronic hardware systems and customer application requirements.
- Demonstrated ability to develop business cases and drive product portfolio growth.
- Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills.
- Excellent communication, influencing and presentation skills.
- Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong customer focus and commercial awareness.
- Experience leading cross-functional projects and influencing stakeholders in a matrix organisation.
- Ability to work effectively across international and multicultural teams.
- Fluent English language skills, both written and spoken.
- Willingness to travel internationally (approximately 10–15%).

Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

United As One for Patients, our purpose in Healthcare is to help create, improve and prolong lives. We develop medicines, intelligent devices and innovative technologies in therapeutic areas such as Oncology, Neurology and Fertility. Our teams work together across 6 continents with passion and relentless curiosity in order to help patients at every stage of life. Joining our Healthcare team is becoming part of a diverse, inclusive and flexible working culture, presenting great opportunities for personal development and career advancement across the globe.

Your Role:

At the intersection of science, strategy, and commercial impact, this role places you at the heart of some of the most consequential decisions in healthcare drug development and commercialization. As an Associate Director within the Global Strategic Insights function, you will serve as a trusted thought partner to therapy area commercial teams — translating complex market dynamics into clear, actionable intelligence that shapes how healthcare assets are launched, grown, and managed across major global markets.

This role will interact primarily with the Rare Tumor and Specialty Therapy Area teams, partnering closely with colleagues who are driving some of the most strategically significant assets in the portfolio.

You will own the end-to-end delivery of insights across one or more GSI disciplines (primary market research, competitive intelligence, or strategic forecasting), ensuring every recommendation is grounded in rigorous analysis and directly informs critical business decisions.

Working with cross-functional partners across commercial strategy, market access and pricing, other GSI functions, and regional insights teams, you will drive insights that elevate decision quality at critical stages of the asset lifecycle.

Who You Are :

- A degree in life sciences, business, economics, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience — is required.
- 5 or more years of experience in at least one global strategic insights discipline — primary market research, competitive intelligence, data analytics, or strategic forecasting — ideally within the pharmaceutical or biopharma industry.
- You have designed and led insights and KPI workstreams for in-market or launch assets, with at least 2 years of direct experience across pre-launch, launch, and post-launch phases.
- You hold deep expertise in one or more of the following: qualitative and quantitative primary market research (study design, discussion guide development, strategic recommendations); global competitive intelligence (trial monitoring, congress coverage, strategic simulation); or topline forecasting (model building, opportunity assessment, scenario analysis).
- You have global experience across two or more major markets — such as the US, China, EU4 and UK, or Japan — and bring a nuanced understanding of how market dynamics differ across regions.
- You work effectively across functions, with a solid understanding of how commercial strategy, market access and pricing, and regional insights teams each contribute to asset success.
- You are comfortable navigating the full medicine lifecycle — from proof-of-concept through in-market management — and understand how insights activities evolve at each stage.
- You communicate complex findings with clarity and confidence, translating analytical outputs into compelling narratives that resonate with senior stakeholders and drive informed decisions.
- English fluent, additional languages are a plus

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

Mast-Jägermeister SE is a premium spirit producers producing in Germany. The company has produced its globally successful herbal liqueur based on a secret recipe of 56 different herbs, blossoms and roots. We pride ourselves on successfully combining the great traditions of a family-owned company with innovative and exciting marketing strategies around the globe. Around 1000 dedicated employees worldwide contribute to the success of the unique herbal liqueur. Become part of our team.

As Jägermeister enters its next chapter, we're looking for our Marketing department in Wolfenbüttel for a 
 

Senior Creative Social Media Manager (f/m/d)

 
who can bring our renewed brand positioning and brand typology to life through bold, social-first content.Working closely with Global Brand Marketing, local markets, creators and agency partners, you'll create engaging content that feels native to each platform while consistently expressing what Jägermeister stands for. You'll combine creativity, cultural awareness and an understanding of social trends to create content that people genuinely want to engage with. The following tasks are waiting for you: 

- Bring Jägermeister's new brand positioning and brand typology to life through engaging social-first content
- Create compelling lo-fi and premium social content across multiple platforms, from concept to execution
- Develop content ideas that translate global campaigns into authentic social experiences
- Stay on top of platform trends, creator culture and emerging content formats, identifying opportunities for Jägermeister to participate in culture
- Collaborate with creators, influencers, agencies and production partners to deliver high-quality content
- Work closely with Brand Marketing and local markets to ensure content is globally consistent while allowing local relevance
- Support community engagement by creating content that sparks conversations and encourages participation
- Monitor content performance and recommend optimisations based on insights and audience behaviour
- Continuously test new formats, technologies and creative approaches to improve content effectiveness
 
We're looking for someone who...
- Is passionate about creating outstanding social media content
- Has a college degree in marketing or communications and several years of relevant professional experience in the creative social media world
- Has proven experience producing engaging content for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and emerging platforms
- Has excellent storytelling, filming, editing and copywriting skills
- Understands how to create content that feels native to each social platform
- Has a strong eye for visual storytelling, trends and internet culture
- Can translate brand strategy into compelling creative execution
- Is comfortable working with creators, agencies and production partners
- Has experience using creative production tools and social analytics platforms
- Is proactive, hands-on and enjoys creating content from idea to publication
- Speaks fluent English; German is a plus

WHO WE ARE

As a family company, we are locally rooted and trade globally. We maintain our traditions carefully and have an innovative culture.

Inspired by our shared mission "BEST NIGHTS OF YOUR LIFE" for our customers, we are united by our enthusiasm for our product, for our brand and for our customers. 

If you see yourself as authentic, social, masterful and bold - join us!

For more insights in Jägermeister as an employer - just click here (https://jobs.jaegermeister.com/en/what-we-offer/) .

- Strong understanding of business strategy combined with deep conceptual knowledge of modern AI and data ecosystems – including LLM frameworks, agentic AI architectures, RAG, and multi-agent orchestration – with the ability to assess technical feasibility and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences
- Proven ability to translate AI concepts into actionable solutions and drive implementation from discovery through iterative delivery – orchestrating AI workflows, copilots, and autonomous agents into business processes using agile frameworks (Scrum, SAFe, or equivalent) and tooling such as Azure DevOps
- Ability to foster a culture of collaboration, curiosity, and responsible AI use within the team
- Awareness of AI governance principles, ethical AI practices, and emerging regulatory frameworks (e.g., EU AI Act) is a plus
- Strong track record of leading projects across multiple functional areas with exposure to different hierarchical levels. More extensive leadership experience is a plus
- Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder engagement skills including the ability to translate technical AI concepts for executive and non-technical audiences
- Proactive, self-motivated work approach with a passion for working in teams
- Proficiency in English and preferably also in German
- Willingness to relocate to Rhine-Main-Area (e.g., Darmstadt, Frankfurt) to allow for regular office presence (2-3 days per week) for close collaboration and network building

What we offer:We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

jobs.occupation: Principal Product Application Engineer (m/f/d) - SiC (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
About the role

As a Principal Product Application Engineer (m/f/d), you will work on developing and validating advanced SiC-based solutions, turning cutting-edge semiconductor technology into real-world applications. You will collaborate with global teams, support customers, and help drive new products to market, combining hands-on engineering with strong application insight.

What you will do

- Design power electronics platforms using SiC technologies
- Run and analyze testing and validation of power systems
- Build demo systems and present solutions to customers
- Support product go-to-market and customer design-in activities
- Create and deliver technical presentations, training, and webinars
- Help shape next-generation semiconductor performance through application insights
- Support device testing, characterization, and modelling
- Collaborate with internal teams, partners, and universities
- Work in a global, multicultural team

What you will bring

- M.Sc. Degree or higher in Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or similar
- 5+ years in the semiconductor industry (power applications focus; WBG preferred)
- Strong experience in hardware design for SiC, GaN, and IGBT applications
- Knowledge of thermal/mechanical design, gate driving, and inductance optimization
- Skilled in measurements, testing, and high-voltage lab environments
- Solid experience with PCB design, simulation, and power module design
- Able to connect device physics, converter design, and customer needs
- Good communication skills; fluent in English (German is a plus)
- Hands-on approach and willingness to travel occasionally

jobs.occupation: (Sr.) Product Manager (m/f/d) – ESD Protection & Filtering (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
About the job

As a Product Manager, you will own and drive the success of a defined product portfolio, combining strategic thinking with strong market and customer focus. Positioned between Regional Marketing and Product Group Leadership, you will translate market insights, customer needs, and business strategy into actionable product decisions. You will work closely with cross-functional teams - including R&D, Marketing, Sales, and Operations - to ensure that products are competitively positioned, financially successful, and aligned with long-term portfolio objectives.

What you will do

- Portfolio owner for automotive ESD/TVS and PowerTVS within the Product Group Protection & Filtering
- Define and execute product strategies across the full product lifecycle (from ideation to end-of-life) while monitoring product performance and support delivery of revenue and profitability targets
- Analyze markets, applications, customer needs, and competitors to identify growth opportunities
- Develop and maintain product roadmaps aligned with portfolio and business goals
- Build, evaluate, and drive business cases for new product opportunities including business case fulfillment
- Collaborate with R&D, Marketing, Sales, and Operations to ensure aligned execution
- Support New Product Introduction (NPI) with clear value propositions and go-to-market plans
- Drive product positioning, pricing, and portfolio optimization
- Contribute to marketing content and product communication materials

What you will need

- Minimum master’s degree in industrial engineering, electrical engineering or semiconductor device physics
- Minimum 5 years of experience in product management, product marketing, sales or business development (ideally in semiconductor or high-tech domain)
- Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills
- Ability to translate technical and market insights into actionable strategies
- Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder (internal/external) management skills
- Experience working in cross-functional and international teams
- Entrepreneurial mindset with strong customer and value focus
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
- Willingness to travel (low frequency)
- Fluent English (additional languages are a plus)

This is your new job

- Work closely with the business team on finance planning & budgeting data preparation & consolidation and conduct regular reviews together with relevant business stakeholders
- Financial process tasks support, incl. Month-End-Closing (MEC), Quarter-End-Closing (QEC) and Year-End-Closing (YEC)
- Financial controlling reporting, incl. forecast planning report, quarterly finance rolling forecast reporting, monthly/quarterly forecast vs. actual variance detailed analysis & reporting on findings
- Collaborate closely with key business stakeholders across Business Groups (BGs), managing R&D project budget and cost tracking, and supporting new project ROI analysis and fulfilment reviews
- Conduct business case validation with project, marketing, and controlling teams, including data-driven comparisons, IRR analysis, investment risk assessment, and presenting insights and recommendations to the management team.
- Support long-term strategic planning, including participation in business strategy discussions and finance data consolidation/reporting
- Support BG key projects in in-house CAPEX investment ROI evaluation, as well as fixed asset management, including budget control, cost tracking, and reporting
- Support Finance projects, particularly cross-BG standardization, reporting automation projects, government subsidy application support (including business case evaluation), and BG internal control process utilization projects.
- Assist with daily finance operations and other ad-hoc finance tasks

This is you

- University degree in Finance, Accounting or Economics, preferably with Accounting/Financial Management Major.
- Min 5 years of relevant working experience in an Accounting or Corporate Finance position in an international corporate environment.
- Experience in a Multinational Company within the semiconductor or related industry is highly preferred
- Fast learner, willing to take challenges and could handle pressure and complete work in timeline
- Skilled in Office tools, PowerPoint, SAP or other ERP platform experience, good excel/data analysis skill is preferred
- Strong communication skills and a collaborative team spirit, particularly in cross-functional and cross-regional environments
- Fluency in English is a must (written and spoken)
- Openness to occasional business travel (10%)

Job Description

About the job

As Business Product Manager you will maximize revenue and profitability of an existing family or families of products within a Product Group’s portfolio. You own the Pricing and Go to Market (G2M) strategy for running portfolios.

The role requires profound knowledge and experience in pricing strategies, channel management and negotiation. Furthermore, a strong ability to manage a complex network of internal and external stakeholders, including customers is required.

What you will do

- Drive revenue and profitability of the assigned product segment by being hungry and willing to win in a challenging and dynamic business environment
- Be the business partner for Business Group (BG) Marketing and Global Sales & Marketing (GSM) in the assigned product portfolio (manufacturing strategy, benefits, longevity etc.)
- Develop key customer & channel strategies together with Product Group Head, Business Marketing Managers, Product Marketing Managers and GSM
- Own the pricing tactics and quote policies for all sales channels for Commercial Marketing in alignment with Product Marketing Managers, Business Marketing Managers and in line with overall Product Group target settings
- Build & maintain G2M material
- Competitor analysis: consolidate input from regions about competitor behaviors, especially pricing strategy at Distribution and OEM channel, inputting (to Industrial) for required cost down roadmaps to reach Product Group margin targets
- Forecasting: align with Demand Management in line with forecast process
- Manage pricing strategy, price setting and special offers for business via Distribution partners
- Drive design-in/design-win success through organizing necessary support to BG Marketing and GSM
- Establish and maintain relationships with key customers and partners in alignment with BG Marketing and GSM.

What you will need

- University degree in electrical and electronic engineering or other related discipline
- Min. 5 years’ experience in Product Marketing or Product Management in the Semiconductor industry
- Proven track record of product (lifecycle) management, with strong understanding of market trends and customer needs, preferably with exposure to international customers
- Strong individual accountability, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively
- Ability to establish lasting relationships and networks in a complex environment across different levels of hierarchies and various stakeholders in a multiple culture environment
- Direct work experience with Power semiconductors or previous experience in product line is preferred
- Knowledge of key business metrics and strong negotiation skills
- Business fluent in English (written and spoken), any other language is a plus
- Willingness to travel occasionally

jobs.occupation: Head of T&O Controlling (m/f/d) (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule) - Rechnungswesen und Controlling)
jobs.description:
About the role

As Head of T&O Controlling, you will lead a global team of finance professionals and be responsible for all financial planning, reporting, forecasting, and governance activities across the T&O organization. Acting as a trusted business partner to the COO, CFO, and senior leadership team, you will provide strategic financial insights, drive investment and performance decisions, and ensure robust controls, compliance, and operational excellence across all T&O sites.

This is your new role

- Lead and develop the Global T&O Controlling team (40+FTEs), including performance management, coaching, and capability building.
- Own the delivery of central T&O financial reporting, ensuring timely, accurate and consistent reporting across all T&O Sites.

jobs.occupation: Senior Logistics Coordinator & Import/Export Analyst (m/f/d) (Fachkraft - Logistik/Materialwirtschaft)
jobs.description:
At Azenta Life Sciences, we support some of the world's leading pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and research organizations by managing the samples and materials that underpin scientific discovery.

Join our Griesheim Biobank team as EU Sample Management Coordinator (Logistics Coordinator & Import/Export Analyst).

How You´ll Add Value

As EU Sample Management Coordinator (m/w/d), you will coordinate the shipment of biological samples, laboratory materials, and related goods throughout Europe and internationally. In this role, you will also help ensure compliance with applicable customs, import/export, and trade regulations by supporting the accurate preparation, review, and coordination of shipment documentation and related processes.

The role offers a combination of hands-on logistics coordination, customs administration, customer communication, and process improvement. Success in this position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while ensuring shipments meet internal standards and external regulatory requirements.

This is an opportunity to join an established international organization and play a key role in supporting scientific and clinical research projects across Europe.

What You´ll Do

- You are part of a four-person logistics team that serves as the central point of contact for logistics matters across our operations, as well as for customers and service providers.
- You coordinate and manage shipping orders in day-to-day operations, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant execution.
- Your routine tasks include packaging and labeling goods ready for shipment, as well as preparing cover letters, freight documents, and customs documentation.
- You support import and export compliance activities, including reviewing shipment data for customs relevance, helping ensure correct classification, documentation completeness, and adherence to internal procedures and applicable regulations.
- You are responsible for coordinating with customs authorities, brokers, and other relevant parties to ensure smooth border crossings, including in time-critical cases.
- You help monitor and maintain records related to import/export activities and support internal compliance checks, audits, and process documentation updates where required.
- You support the continuous development of our logistics processes and service offerings, including with a focus on compliance, efficiency, and sustainability.
- You also support incoming goods processing when needed, checking for completeness and informing the relevant departments, for example in the case of deliveries of chemicals and reagents.
- Additionally, you are responsible for inventory, as well as managing and ordering logistics-related materials.
- You understand and strictly adhere to standard operating procedures (SOPs) in English and contribute to maintaining high ethical and quality standards in all shipment-related activities.

What You´ll Bring

- Successfully completed vocational training or a degree in business administration, logistics, customs, or a similar qualification.
- Practical work experience in logistics, customs, import/export, or within a freight forwarding company.
- Sound understanding of customs clearance processes, shipping documentation, and import/export compliance requirements; experience with dangerous goods is a plus.
- Familiarity with trade compliance topics such as tariff classification, country of origin, customs value, restricted party screening, or license-related checks is an advantage.
- Very good communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Reliability clearance in accordance with Section 7 of the German Aviation Security Act (LuftSiG).
- Team player with enthusiasm for working in an international team.
- Proficient in standard MS Office software; advanced Excel skills and familiarity with ERP systems are an advantage.
- Forward-thinking and solution-oriented approach to work, with a strong awareness of compliance and best practices.
- Strong hands-on mentality.
- Attention to detail and excellent prioritization skills.
- Fluent in German and English (B2 level or higher).

What We Offer

- Become part of a company that contributes to groundbreaking scientific developments and therapies.
- Positive company culture and strong teamwork across all locations.
- Individual development opportunities to strengthen your international competencies and language skills.
- Attractive workplace in Griesheim with excellent transport connections.
- 30 days of annual leave to support a healthy work-life balance.
- Partnership with pme Familienservice to support employees in all life situations.
- Additional benefits include a stock purchase program, life insurance, company pension scheme, profit sharing, five additional childcare sick days, and a corporate benefits online shopping platform.

Contact

Azenta Germany GmbH

Im Leuschnerpark 1b

64347 Griesheim

About Nexperia

As a leading international semiconductor company, we operate in a complex, fast-moving environment where high quality legal advice truly matters. We are looking for an experienced Senior Legal Counsel who combines strong corporate and M&A expertise with business acumen and a collaborative mindset.

About the role

In this senior role you:

- Act as secretary to the Nexperia Germany Board of Directors.

What you will need

- M&A experience (considered a strong advantage).
- Experience working closely with Finance, Treasury and/or Tax departments.

- Proven experience working with C‑suite and senior management stakeholders.
